title: node-postgres fails with 'SASL: SCRAM-SERVER-FIRST-MESSAGE: client password must be a string'
symptoms: Error: SASL: SCRAM-SERVER-FIRST-MESSAGE: client password must be a string
Works in one shell or locally and fails in another shell or in the deployed environment
cause: The password reached pg as undefined, almost always because the database URL or PGPASSWORD was not loaded into the process. PostgreSQL 14 made scram-sha-256 the default password encryption, so the failure surfaces inside the SCRAM handshake instead of as a plain login error.
fix: Load the environment before creating the pool and fail fast when the URL is missing.
affected: pg 8.x against PostgreSQL 14 and later, or any server using scram-sha-256
